'GTA 6' chapter 1 is so good that I'm afraid to move on to chapter 2
articles.chapeau: Please help me.
articles.txt:
I've run into a very stupid problem with Grand Theft Auto VI , a game I love so far.
Namely, I'm having a surprisingly difficult time moving on from chapter 1 of the game's sprawling crime story. For a couple of real-life days now, I've been sitting on the edge of finishing GTA 6 's opening stanza with very little motivation to move on. At the time of writing, I have literally one story mission left to go before the first chapter ends, and almost nothing of substance left to do otherwise.
But as much as I know I need to break through and see the rest of what GTA 6 has to offer, it's hard to resist the call to just live out Jason Duval's mundane daily routine for eternity.
Warning: There are some light spoilers for early parts of GTA 6's story in the following section.
For those who haven't played GTA 6 yet or are still in the early stages like me, chapter 1 follows Jason's meager existence as a sort of paid goon for Brian, a local boatyard owner who dabbles in drug trafficking on the side. The other protagonist, Lucia, gets out of prison partway through the chapter, but for most of it, she's not playable yet. Most of the story and side missions in chapter 1 focus on Jason doing little odd jobs that occasionally spiral into chaotic violence. He spends time with his girlfriend or buddies and otherwise just kind of chills when he's not doing all the crime stuff.
GTA 6 chapter 1 immediately establishes an endearingly ordinary routine for Jason, at least by action video game protagonist standards. Every in-game day I wake up, feed the pet snake, drink coffee, work out, drink a protein shake, and take a shower before heading out to do whatever it takes to get enough money to set up a nest egg for Jason and Lucia.
While there are some minor gameplay incentives to doing all of that, GTA 6 doesn't outright demand any of it from the player. I'm just doing it because it's a legitimately interesting loop, especially by the standards of big-budget mainstream games. I'm not just endlessly traversing between icons on a map and shooting some bad guys when I get to each one. I feel like an active participant in the everyday lives of two adults, which at the very least is novel for this type of game. It also helps that Brian is voiced by Stephen Root, so you spend most of chapter 1 being yelled at by Buck Strickland , and that's lovely.
I mean, most of my favorite missions so far have barely involved crime at all. The one where Jason and Lucia go to a bar after she gets out of prison is a remarkable virtual rendition of a romantic night out, while I've already lavished the Carly Rae Jepsen mission with praise on this website.
All of that is why I'm having such a hard time moving forward with the main story. I know in my heart that chapter 2 will likely introduce a new setting with new stakes, new mechanics, and an increased focus on crime. And all of that will probably be fantastic in its own right, but it won't be the same as the game I've loved up until now.
And if that's the feeling Rockstar intends to elicit in players when chapter 1 draws to a close, I would say they pulled it off. Maybe even a little too well. Recommended deals for you HBO Max — top pick for premium content

articles.t: The state of GTA 6 on PC: Everything you need to know
articles.chapeau: The race to play GTA 6 on PC is moving by the hour, so here is where every fan port, project, and emulation attempt stands right now.
articles.txt:
Grand Theft Auto 6 is undoubtedly the biggest game ever created, and some might argue it's the biggest entertainment project of all time. Rockstar has confirmed that GTA 6 made $3.79 billion on the first day of launch, shattering entertainment records. It was the most pre-ordered title on both the PlayStation and Xbox stores, and it even earned a spectacular Metacritic score of 99. However, one thing was missing from GTA 6's historic launch.
Rockstar's masterpiece launched on the PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, but not on PC. That wasn't a surprise omission, but it's still a big chunk of the player base that missed out on experiencing GTA 6 at the same time as the rest of the world. We have come to expect this pattern from Rockstar, as GTA 5 and Red Dead Redemption 2 both launched on PC some time after their original console launches. Most likely, that is exactly what will happen with GTA 6. However, it looks like PC players aren't waiting around.
First, we have to talk about what Rockstar has officially said. Surprisingly, Rockstar hasn't confirmed a PC version yet, and neither has Take-Two, its parent company. However, given the history of previous Rockstar launches, we can make an educated guess that an official PC version will eventually come out. The closest thing to a timeline is a GamesBeat report in which four industry sources said Rockstar is targeting the first quarter of 2027 for GTA 6 on PC. That was in October, and we haven't heard any new rumors since.
6 A car meet in Grand Theft Auto VI, which launched on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S without a confirmed PC version. VIEW GALLERY - 6 IMAGES Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick said in November that Take-Two is beefing up its defenses against AI-assisted reverse engineering and unofficial PC ports, so they were definitely prepared for the onslaught. Shortly after GTA 6's November 19 launch, people started testing the waters, trying to port GTA 6 to PC themselves. Of course, nobody had any luck at first, but the breakthrough came via notorious leaker Cyberleek, who had been pestering Rockstar for months before launch.
On November 19, Cyberleek announced it had a full November 2026 Xbox build. The roughly 209 GB package was uploaded shortly after, but without the main executable. That part was locked behind a countdown, partly tied to a meme coin goal. Regardless of that attempt to pump up his meme coin, Cyberleek dropped the .exe on November 23, alongside a statement calling the whole thing a protest against subscriptions. At this point, it is important to remember this wasn't a PC build, but an Xbox Series X one. Getting the files and the executable did not mean you could just copy them to your PC, run the .exe, and jump into Leonida. It's not quite that simple.

articles.t: Rockstar is handing out 100 of these gorgeous limited-edition GTA 6 PS5 consoles, and you can't buy one
articles.chapeau: After giving custom GTA 6 PS5 Pro consoles to Miami Heat players, Rockstar is sending them to creators rather than selling them.
articles.txt:
Rockstar is distributing, not selling, at least 100 custom GTA 6 PS5 Pro consoles, first to Miami Heat players and now to streamers and influencers. The Vice City-styled units remain promotional only, while black and white limited-edition DualSense controllers are available for $84.99.
As an Amazon Associate, we earn from qualifying purchases. TweakTown may also earn commissions from other affiliate partners at no extra cost to you.
Rockstar Games is not selling the custom GTA 6 PS5 Pro units. Instead, it is giving them away carefully and in very limited numbers. Reports confirm that at least 100 of these special consoles exist.
The machines feature a dark gray-and-black finish with etched palm-tree patterns across the side plates, the GTA 6 logo, and neon teal-to-magenta accents that reference Vice City's nightlife. Each unit carries a unique serial number under the Rockstar symbol.
Popular Now: The state of GTA 6 on PC: Everything you need to know The first wave went to Miami Heat players just before the November 19 release as part of the team's Vice City-themed collaboration. Those packages arrived in fitted hard cases that also included matching DualSense controllers and a physical copy of Grand Theft Auto 6.
A second batch is now being delivered to streamers and influencers. The streamer Davy Jones showed one of those consoles, with images shared by the videotech account on X. The styling matches the previous promotional units, confirming that Rockstar produced a deliberate, small run rather than one-off customs.
2 A numbered Rockstar badge marks the lower corner of the custom GTA 6 PS5 Pro, a promotional edition that isn’t sold at retail. (Image: Davy Jones) VIEW GALLERY - 2 IMAGES The limited-edition DualSense controllers are a different story. Sony and Rockstar released both black and white versions for retail sale at $84.99, and those have been available at major stores and PlayStation Direct.
Unfortunately, the console remains strictly promotional. Despite years of fan requests for a proper GTA PS5 Pro bundle or even just official faceplates, neither Sony nor Rockstar has provided anything for the public.

GTA 6 : Rockstar North explique enfin la difficulté du jeu
articles.chapeau: Rob Nelson et Scott Mitchell expliquent comment GTA 6 trouve le juste milieu entre GTA 4 et GTA 5, entre missions ouvertes, zones dures et accessibilité.
articles.txt:
Depuis la sortie de Grand Theft Auto VI le 19 novembre sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S, un débat revient sans cesse dans les discussions de joueurs : les missions principales sont-elles trop permissives, ou au contraire mieux dosées que par le passé ? Fidèle à ses habitudes, Rockstar Games n’a inclus aucun sélecteur Facile, Normal ou Difficile au lancement de la campagne. Le studio écossais vient finalement de détailler sa méthode d’équilibrage par la voix de deux de ses responsables clés.
Interrogé sur la courbe de défi du jeu, Rob Nelson , codirecteur et responsable du développement chez Rockstar North, a reconnu que le studio s’est appuyé sur les données et les retours accumulés sur ses deux précédents volets majeurs. Selon lui, le contraste était net entre les deux approches.
« Lors de la conception des missions, nous devons composer avec un immense public aux niveaux très variés. En observant nos titres précédents, nous avons constaté que GTA 4 était parfois un peu trop punitif par endroits, et que GTA 5 était peut-être trop facile pour certains joueurs. Notre objectif était de trouver un juste milieu avec GTA 6. »
Ce réglage n’a rien d’anodin lorsque l’on sait que les équipes internes jouent aux mêmes séquences pendant des années. Rob Nelson explique que les développeurs et les testeurs finissent par connaître chaque position ennemie par cœur, ce qui les pousse naturellement à durcir les affrontements. Il a donc fallu mener un vrai travail de recul pour « déconstruire » cet excès de difficulté et bâtir une aventure que la majorité du public puisse « apprécier, plutôt que subir ». Cette philosophie prolonge les ajustements de dernière minute apportés à l’IA partenaire de Jason et Lucia juste avant le lancement.
L’un des reproches historiques adressés aux productions Rockstar concernait la rigidité de leurs scripts, capables de déclencher un écran d’échec dès qu’un joueur s’éloignait de quelques mètres du tracé prévu. Sur ce point précis, Scott Mitchell , producteur design en charge des missions et de la narration chez Rockstar North, assure que la copie a été revue.
« Nous avons fait un effort conscient pour nous assurer que les conditions d’échec soient appropriées et ne soient pas utilisées à outrance pendant la conception des missions de GTA 6. Nous voulions garder les situations ouvertes et ne pas brider l’usage des mécaniques par les joueurs, comme l’infiltration, tout en conservant les séquences cinématographiques explosives à grand spectacle qui font notre signature et que le public attend. Nous avons le sentiment d’avoir trouvé un bon équilibre. »
Dans les faits, cela se traduit par des fusillades moins punitives au moindre écart et des phases d’approche plus souples, sans sacrifier le rythme spectaculaire des braquages et des poursuites de Leonida.
Pour les habitués qui jugent la trame principale trop accessible, Rob Nelson rappelle que la difficulté ne se mesure pas uniquement aux missions scénarisées. La taille de Leonida a permis aux équipes de segmenter le niveau d’exigence en dehors du chemin critique.
Le dirigeant cite explicitement certains objectifs optionnels du monde ouvert, notamment les complexes fortement gardés (compounds) et les façades criminelles (fronts) . Ces zones ont été calibrées pour opposer une résistance bien plus coriace, afin d’offrir aux joueurs en quête de défi un terrain exigeant sans bloquer ceux qui souhaitent simplement suivre le parcours de Jason et Lucia jusqu’au générique.
Même sans menu de difficulté traditionnel, Rockstar Games a glissé deux leviers très concrets dans Paramètres > Gameplay > Accessibilité , activables ou désactivables à tout moment pendant la partie :
Le jeu prévient qu’activer ces options modifie sensiblement l’équilibrage pensé par le studio. Un détail rassure toutefois les chasseurs de complétion : contrairement aux codes de triche, qui restent verrouillés jusqu’à la fin de l’histoire et désactivent la sauvegarde, ces aides d’accessibilité ne bloquent aucun objectif de notre guide complet des 55 trophées PS5 et succès Xbox de GTA 6 .
Entre une campagne pensée pour rester fluide, des complexes annexes réservés aux profils plus tactiques et des options d’accessibilité sans pénalité sur les trophées, Rockstar North assume clairement sa ligne : laisser chacun doser sa traversée de Leonida sans jamais imposer de curseur officiel au démarrage.

articles.t: Crisis clinicians report more online comments flagged since Grand Theft Auto 6 release
articles.chapeau: As the mobile crisis provider for most of the state, clinicians say they are seeing more online comments flagged and reported to authorities since the release of Grand Theft Auto 6.
articles.txt:
JACKSON, Tenn. (WBBJ) - As the mobile crisis provider for most of the state, Youth Villages said they are seeing more online comments flagged and reported to authorities since the release of Grand Theft Auto 6.
Many of those comments mimic violent or illegal activity from the game. Crisis teams are working hand-in-hand with law enforcement and investigators to assess and respond to threats of violence.
They stress that even “jokes” or game-related references posted online can trigger real-life police contact and tie up limited public safety resources.
“We always say ‘leave it up to the parents discretion’ in regard to if they feel like their kid is mature enough, or they think they can be on these games and not say anything that’s inappropriate. But if they don’t think their kid can handle that, maybe you should have a discussion or probably not buy the game for them,” Charles Chatman, program supervisor for Youth Villages Crisis Program, said.
Leaders are urging parents to talk with their kids now about what they say online, reminding them that every post is taken seriously when it comes to school safety and community threats.

articles.chapeau: Rockstar recreated an embarrassing mishap in Florida infrastructure.

(Image credit: Rockstar) {alert('Link copied')}).catch(err => {console.error('Failed to copy: ', err)})" data-platform="copy_link" data-action="" class="font-ui-heading py-2 text-sm text-neutral-700 hover:bg-neutral-100 transition-colors no-underline block cursor-pointer border-0 bg-transparent w-full text-left normal-case" aria-label="Copy link" role="menuitem" data-analytics-id="article-social" analytics-label="utility-bar-social-share-copy-link" analytics-name="utility-bar-secondary" data-mrf-recirculation="article-social"> Copy link Facebook X Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter When you're exploring a world as realistic and well-observed as GTA 6 's Leonida, it's rare for a piece of benign infrastructure to stick out. But on night one of my playthrough, I clocked some weird streetlights.
A stylistic choice by Rockstar? Maybe, but it's awfully specific, and I had a feeling there was a deeper intention behind it. So I DMed my buddy Henry, an honest-to-god Floridian who was also playing GTA 6, and asked what's up. At first he thought strange streetlights in the Key Lento area of the map were special lights meant to not disorient turtles, but those are typically red, so probably not. And that doesn't explain the purple ones.
So Henry reached out to friends in south Florida, the region that Leonida's biggest cities are based on, and they cracked the case wide open.
"The purple [lights] are definitely real. We have a ton of them down here because whoever is in charge of that in the government bought a bunch of defective lights," the anonymous Floridian responded.
Yes, actual Florida cities are lit by these dubiously dim, yet undeniably cool purple lamps. According to ClickOrlando , residents first started reporting the purple streetlights in 2023. They put up hundreds of these things across the state before they started malfunctioning—it was such a kerfuffle that the government eventually released a statement saying their vendor really screwed the pooch.
Keep up to date with the most important stories and the best deals, as picked by the PC Gamer team.
Apparently the cause was a "spectral shift caused by phosphor displacement," which essentially means the LED lights were always blue, but the coating that was supposed to make appear yellow or white or whatever didn't work. The powers that be said the malfunctioning lights would be replaced, but judging by our own sources in the state, they haven't gotten them all.
So that's fun. If you already heard about this somewhere (other than your Floridian friend), it's probably because YouTuber AnyAustin also clocked these lights in his video published yesterday. Glad I'm not the only one who couldn't resist this rabbit hole.
I like how Rockstar didn't go overboard with these lights—just like the genuine article, they're in and around parts of Leonida, but not everywhere. I'm still not sure how to explain the turquoise ones, though. A lot of local news, Reddit, and YouTube skimming did not produce a clear answer, other than other cities in America that do have green streetlights sometimes. Perhaps Key Lento has lamps busted in a slightly different way, or it's just a calming shade of blue that Rockstar thought looked nice. It does, to be fair.

GTA 6: Missing Tourists Locations in Port Gellhorn
articles.chapeau: Where to find every missing person in Port Gellhorn
articles.txt:
When you reach Chapter 2 of GTA 6 , you can pick up an Exploration mission that tasks you with finding missing tourists in Port Gellhorn. In this GTA 6 guide , we reveal all missing tourist locations in Port Gellhorn . This mission will tie into a Strangers & Freaks Mission based around Alvan .
Having started Chapter 2 , you'll need to see Linda, The Manager about paying for your room at the Starlet Motel . In the office she's in, look at the missing person posters on the wall, to her left as you look at Linda.
Interact with the posters and then zoom in on them to have the game register you've seen them. When you back out, the game will add the Kelly County Tip Line to your mobile phone contacts.
Ring their phone number by doing the following: Up > press on Contacts > All Contacts > scroll down to Kelly County Tip Line . This will give you the mission to find Gellhorn's Missing Tourists .
If you missed the posters the first time around, here's the location of the Starlet Motel on the map:
With the mission in your Exploration log on the map screen, you won't actually have any markers or hints to follow that tell you where to go next.
So, let us help you with the next step: you need to find a warehouse in Port Gellhorn that contains a series of photographs that hint at the whereabouts of the missing tourists.
When you're in Port Gellhorn, go to Moses and his garage. Outside of it, across the street is Burnout Scooters . To the right of the shop is a building shaped like a bunker that's covered in foliage. Here's what you're looking for:
Here it is on the map screen, zoomed in close on Port Gellhorn :
Go up to the shutter to try and open it, but it'll immediately come back down after you break the lock. Instead, go around to the right of the building and run to the opposite end of it. In between the two red barrels at the end is a crawlspace you can use to get inside:
Once in there, walk through the warehouse until you find an interior room with a red light in it. Go through until you reach a room with a chair pointed at a series of lockers.
Investigate the picture frames in the three lockers, and you'll take pictures of them. These are your clues; these are the missing tourists.
Missing Tourists Locations Using the clues and hints from the warehouse, we can now start to locate the missing tourists. Below you'll discover the locations of the three missing tourists, covering the Junkyard Photo , the Tree Photo , and the Trailer Park Photo .
For the location of the Trailer Park Photo , go to the far north of Port Gellhorn , where the water tower is. Below the water tower is a small trailer park:
Here's where you need to go on the map, zoomed in close on Port Gellhorn :
Enter the blue trailer on the left and examine the broken floorboards on the right as soon as you enter. Underneath them, you'll find the remains of a body. You're then able to report the body.
Missing Tourist Location #2 (Junkyard Photo) For the Junkyard Photo , go to the Pay 'N' Spray in the middle of the Port Gellhorn region. Next to it is a junkyard full of cars. Here's what you're looking for:
In the junkyard, you need to find a pink car. When you've found it, interact with the trunk to find another body. Here's the pink car:
Having opened the trunk, you can once again report the remains of the body to the Kelly County Tip Line .
For the final missing tourist location, depicted in the Tree Photo , you need to head just out of town on the southwestern side. You're looking for a small body of water that's separate from the larger lake that surrounds the region.
Here's where you need to go on the map, zoomed in on Port Gellhorn (if you were to zoom out, the body of water is on the border between Port Gellhorn and Wild Hog Point ):
Look into the water and you'll discover a submerged car. Click to Examine Car and you'll look under the water to find the final missing tourist, or the skeleton of them. You can then report that body too.
At this point, it will seem like nothing happens. What you need to do is wait for the Kelly County Tip Line to call you back after you've reported the three bodies. If you're working through the main story of Chapter 2 , then you should receive the call once Jason becomes a playable character again.
We have documented what comes next in our Return to the Trophy Room walkthrough .

articles.t: All Peewees Billboard locations in GTA 6
articles.chapeau: How to claim the Peewees Billboard grand prize
articles.txt:
Peewees Billboards are one of the many scannable WAiNK collectibles in Grand Theft Auto 6 , but they're also part of the Mr. Enigma X Peewees scavenger hunt. Mr. Enigma, a play on Dr. Pepper, and the Peewees, a play on Popeyes, have teamed up to create a challenge where you must find four Peewees billboards, and you'll earn a valuable reward.
All the info you're given is that there is a billboard in the following areas: Vice-Dale, Mariana County, Lummox County, and Leonard County. As these areas are fairly large, it can take a long time to find them.
To save you some time, we've listed where you can find every Peewees Billboard in GTA 6 below.
To start the Mr. Enigma X Peewees scavenger hunt, look out for a Peewees post on Snapmatic, or you can look for one of the four Peewees billboards. After you start, you'll get a text from Chicken Challenge, telling you that you've entered the scavenger hunt. They'll also send you a clue that points you toward another billboard when you start the challenge and every time you find one.
There are four Peewees Billboards in GTA 6 , with one in Vice-Dale, Mariana County, Lummox County, and Leonard County. To mark them off the list, head to their location and scan them using WAiNK (hold Up on your D-pad).
Below, we explain where you can find each billboard in detail.
Graphic: Johnny Yu/Polygon | Source images: Rockstar Games via Polygon The Vice-Dale Peewees Billboard is on the west side of Balsero , which is the northwest corner of Vice-Dale County . The billboard itself is between Route US-10 and US-35 , which is just northwest of Randy's shop .
Graphic: Johnny Yu/Polygon | Source images: Rockstar Games via Polygon The Mariana County Peewees Billboard is technically in Big Pine in Grassrivers , but it's very close to the border between Grassrivers and North Mariana County . Along the border, you'll find three dome-shaped buildings and Route US-82 . Head northeast of the dome-shaped buildings , and look in the median strip to find this Peewee Billboard.
Graphic: Johnny Yu/Polygon | Source images: Rockstar Games via Polygon The Lummox County Peewees Billboard is located on the border between South West Lummox County and Mount Kalaga National Park . The billboard is just west of Route US-628 . Head north from the junction that connects US-628 to SR-73 , and you'll find the billboard on your left.
Graphic: Johnny Yu/Polygon | Source images: Rockstar Games via Polygon The Leonard County Peewees Billboard is located in the northwest corner of Waning Sands . The billboard is just next to SR-27 , which is between Lake Leonida and Mount Hailes Club . Look northeast of Lake Leonida, and you'll find the golf course. Follow along the road until you find the Peewees Billboard.
After you find every Peewees Billboard, you'll receive a text from Chicken Challenge, telling you that you won... almost! You just need to solve one more puzzle, but they don't tell you what the puzzle is.
Graphic: Johnny Yu/Polygon | Source images: Rockstar Games via Polygon If you take a look back at the clues that Chicken Challenge has been sending you, you'll notice that a couple of letters in each photo are covered by the Peewees logo. The following letters are blocked off: V - L - I - L - L - E - B - E. Now, it looks like a bunch of gibberish, but if you scramble the letters, you'll get Belville , which is the southern region of Leonard County .
Graphic: Johnny Yu/Polygon | Source images: Rockstar Games via Polygon To claim your grand prize, you need to head to the Peewees in Belville, which is just east of the hospital. Alternatively, you can open your map, scroll down to the "Fast Food" section of the "Food & Drink" tab, and select the Peewees in Belville to speed up the process.
Graphic: Johnny Yu/Polygon | Source images: Rockstar Games via Polygon Head inside and speak with the manager to claim your reward, which is a Peewees hat, a Peewees shirt, and free Peewees food!

Can you play GTA 6 from an external hard drive on PS5 or Xbox Series X/S? - Engadget
articles.chapeau: With a hefty install size, GTA 6 will take up a significant chunk of your PS5 or Xbox Series X/S storage space.
articles.txt:
Asanka Ratnayake/Getty Images Add Engadget on Google: Preferred Source Google Discover Grand Theft Auto 6 is the biggest game of the year by some distance, having racked up $3.79 billion in pre-orders and day-one sales . On PlayStation 5 alone, more than 39 million unique players took control of dual protagonists Jason and Lucia on opening weekend, making it the biggest game debut in the 32-year history of PlayStation.
There will be many other folks who want to play the game and haven't had a chance to jump in yet. One thing they should note is that, with a hefty install size , GTA 6 will take up a significant chunk of their PS5 or Xbox Series X/S storage space.
You might be wondering whether you can install GTA 6 on an external hard drive to avoid having to delete other games and data from your console. You can move GTA 6 to your external storage when you're not playing it. However, to run the game locally, you'll need to have it installed on your system's built-in storage, an SDD you've installed in your PS5 or a compatible NVMe expansion card that's plugged into your Xbox.
As with many other recent games, GTA 6 needs to take advantage of the fast-loading capabilities of the PS5 and Xbox Series X/S. The consoles are unable to load data for these titles quickly enough from an external hard drive over a USB connection . For the same reason, disc-based PS5 and Xbox Series X games are installed onto system storage before you can play them. The PS5 can run PS4 games from external storage, though. Likewise, an Xbox Series X/S can run older Xbox One and Xbox 360 titles directly from an external hard drive.
That said, there is a way to play GTA 6 without first having to free up a whole lot of console storage space. It's possible to stream the game from the cloud on Xbox Series X/S . There are two things to note if you'd like to go with that option, including that Xbox just brought in new cloud gaming time limits . Game Pass subscribers get up to 15 hours of cloud gaming included each month. You can pay extra for more access. Also, GTA 6 is limited to Xbox Series S graphics settings on Xbox Cloud Gaming.
On the PlayStation side, cloud streaming works on PS5 and PlayStation Portal if you're a PlayStation Plus Premium subscriber. There are no cloud gaming time limits on PS Plus. You'll also need to purchase GTA 6 for PS5 or Xbox Series X/S to stream the game from the cloud, as it's not included in the PS Plus or Game Pass libraries — and it probably won't be for quite some time.

articles.t: GTA 6: How To Permanently Increase All Stats
articles.chapeau: If you're looking to buff all of Jason and Lucia's stats in GTA 6, we've got you covered.
articles.txt:
By Nicholas Becher Published Nov 25, 2026, 5:02 PM EST Nicholas Becher is a gaming journalist with an MFA in Creative Writing from FAU. With extensive experience playing video games, he covers all forms of gaming content at Screen Rant, from breaking news to the latest fan theories. Most-played games range from Clair Obscur to Civ to Elden Ring to Halo 2 and beyond. Sign in to your ScreenRant account There are three main stats you'll need to pay attention to throughout your Grand Theft Auto 6 playthrough: Strength, Cardio, and Focus. Jason and Lucia each have their own individual stats, which play an important role in everything from surviving intense shootouts to escaping the police and clearing heat on foot.
Strength determines your maximum health, Cardio governs your stamina, and Focus dictates how long you can slow down time during combat. Improving all three will make for a much smoother playthrough, especially as missions become more challenging later on. While certain activities provide temporary benefits, there are also ways to permanently increase each of these stats in GTA 6 , making it well worth investing time in both characters outside the main story.
You can check each character's current stats by opening their individual profiles in the Jason & Lucia menu, while the Fitness app on your phone allows you to track your workout progress. Each of the three main stats can be improved through different activities, though neglecting your Strength and Cardio workout windows will eventually cause you to lose some of your progress.
However, certain side missions and Easter eggs in GTA 6 reward you with permanent increases to your maximum health, stamina, or Focus. Unlike the gains you make at the gym, these bonuses don't require regular maintenance to retain. Most of these encounters aren't marked on your map, and there's almost no indication that completing them will improve your stats. The following are all the currently reported encounters that offer permanent stat increases:
One of the more bizarre ways to permanently increase your maximum health in GTA 6 involves participating in a satanic ritual. Head to the northern area of Port Gellhorn between midnight and 4 AM, where you'll find two metalheads hanging out inside an open garage illuminated by red lights.
Approach them while you're alone and agree to accompany them in their van. You'll eventually arrive at a campfire, which you'll need to stare into to trigger a sequence that transports you to an unholy realm. Make your way through the encounter and defeat Satan to receive a permanent increase to your maximum health. You'll also be rewarded with the unique Hellspawn Comshot 12 shotgun, a new tattoo, and a Circles of Hell shirt.
There are several different ways to permanently increase your maximum stamina in GTA 6, making Cardio one of the easiest stats to improve without having to constantly worry about getting to the gym.
To initiate "The Final Flush," head to the men's public restroom on Corsair Key and look for the Stop! Don't Flush poster. Scan the QR code using the WAiNK It app on your phone and respond to the subsequent message with "TRUTH."
You'll eventually arrange a nighttime meeting with Dr. Merle at Frank's Waffles in Tequesta, after which you'll need to accompany him to a sewage treatment facility. Once you've completed Merle's rather unfortunate experiment, make sure you enter the chamber yourself. Doing so will reward you with a permanent increase to your maximum stamina.
Starting in Chapter 2, you'll be able to find a "Pilot Wanted" flyer outside the Starlet Motel office, which introduces you to Kyle McKittrick and his farming operation. Pursue Kyle's questline until you've completed the "Collect Chemicals for Kyle" mission .
Kyle will eventually offer you the opportunity to sample one of his enormous, chemically enhanced strawberries. Make sure you accept his offer, as eating the strawberry will permanently increase your maximum stamina. You'll be able to return to the farm and eat additional strawberries for temporary benefits, but you won't receive another permanent stat increase from doing so.
Head to the construction site along the eastern shore of Lake Tallaloko, just north of Millport, where you'll find an open orange shipping container. Inside the container is a mysterious object labeled "???" that you can interact with to consume a mushroom. Doing so will trigger an elaborate hallucination involving a surreal platforming sequence.

articles.t: Fort Valley State alum joins GTA 6 as Vice City voice character 'Lil Gunna'
articles.chapeau: Grand Theft Auto 6, the hottest game of the year, is here, and it's set in Leonida,  inspired by many different areas of FL. You may bump heads with people from all over the country, including FVSU alumnus Jachin Myers.
articles.txt:
Watch Fort Valley State alum joins GTA 6 as Vice City voice character 'Lil Gunna' by Joshua Harrison-Williams
3 VIEW ALL PHOTOS Fort Valley State alum Jachin Myers joins GTA 6 as Vice City voice character 'Lil Gunna', (@JachinHasan on Instagram) Comment on this story 0 Comment Share story Share topics: Voice acting Rockstar Games Motion capture Lil Gunna Vice City Jachin Myers Fort Valley State Grand Theft Auto 6 MACON, Ga. (WGXA) — Grand Theft Auto 6, the hottest game of the year, has officially arrived. As you explore the Florida-inspired streets of Leonida, you’ll cross paths with characters from all over the country, including a voice from right here in Middle Georgia: Fort Valley State University alum Jachin Myers.
Myers is a voice actor in the game's local population, and despite his previous big screen roles, this is the first time Myers has voice acted on the main stage.
"I probably auditioned for him like eight to ten times, you know...before they landed on the role and it was one of those things to where I did it in October of 2025, and it wasn't until earlier this year around like March...April somewhere in there that I got a call back," Myers said.
Fort Valley State alum Jachin Myers joins GTA 6 as Vice City voice character 'Lil Gunna', (Courtesy of: Rockstar Games)
After taking a flight out to Rockstar's California studios, Myers says he had a two-day recording session to get his lines set for the role.
"They have the lines and stuff already up as far as the recording process; they actually did a little bit of a motion capture, so I put on a rig to capture some of my facial performance with it as I was delivering the lines, and the director would go through different scenarios like, okay, the character's coming out of a shop, he's going to do this, and you know xyz with this character," said Myers.
Myers...in Vice City, known as "Lil Gunna," has been in massive roles before Rockstar's flagship game. As a stuntman, he appeared in Black Panther, Stranger Things and BMF. While these are major roles, he says he must always remind himself to stay in the moment as he earns other opportunities.
Myers said, "You know there there's so much like if you're thinking about oh, this is for GTA. Oh, this is black panther. Oh, this is Avengers, and oh, this is, you know, you might be messing up something that's right in front of you that you need to do right, and you just blew your whole opportunity because you're so wide-eyed at the fact. Oh, this is this, this is that."
From graduating with a mechanical engineering degree from Fort Valley in 2016 to the big screen today, the Columbus, Ga, native says finding opportunity in Middle Georgia made moving to the big city and taking on acting roles easy pickings.
"It's like, look dawg, you understand this: people in Fort Valley just doing this without half of the resources, the connections; it's people in Middle Georgia, Warner Robins, making it," Myers said. "It's people from these areas that have gone all across the world to go do great things...like Fort Valley is like the best kept secret in the world man."

So, if you get your hands on a copy of GTA 6 and make your way through the Leonida Keys and Vice-Dade County, keep your eyes peeled for Lil Gunna.

But those huge bank vault doors are completely impenetrable, and confusingly, even after you've learned how to drill into a vault as part of a Chapter 3 story mission , you still won't be able to open vault doors in open world bank robberies.
Here's the trick: you've got to get someone to open bank vault doors for you. Only then can you steal all that sweet cash.
Your GTA 6 fence , Yasmani, will begin offering you tips once you start selling him stolen goods in Chapter 3: jewelry store heists targeting specific items and which ATM jobs have the most cash, for example. These are worth doing anyway as they get you the snap gun .
Complete every job Yasmani has and keep asking for more, and in Chapter 4 he'll offer you a tip for $10,000. Pay it, and he'll give you the locations of two security vans (armored cars) in Vice City. They'll show up on your map as pink icons.
There are multiple banks with vaults that armored cars visit. While driving around the areas near these banks and keeping your eyes peeled, you may spot an armored car without Yasmani's tip. It could take quite a while, though!
You can see which banks have vaults by looking under "Big Bank Jobs" in the "Robberies" category on your map. There are four big banks in Ocean Beach, two downtown, one in Tequesta, and one at Vice City International Airport.
Follow the armored car until it parks outside a bank. Watch as one of the drivers gets out and walks into the bank. You can follow him to see where he goes, though bank layouts differ and he may take different routes. He may walk through the front doors, or he may go in a side entrance or a roll-up door in the back.
Once he's all the way inside—not just inside the front doors, but deep into the bank—he'll head to the vault and open it.
You can't open that vault yourself! Only the armored car driver can. That's the trick.
Once the guard is in the back of the bank, begin the robbery. Search for the vault in the back. You may need to use explosives to open the door the guard went through, or you can look for a door you can open with the snap gun. You'll find the vault door open with the armored car driver nearby. Subdue him and grab all the cash off the cart inside the vault.
There are several safe deposit boxes in the vault you can open for extra loot. Use your focus ability to highlight which boxes you can loot, and shoot them to open them up. You can also blow open all the boxes at once using a grenade or sticky bomb. Grab the loot from each.
If you really want to clean the place out, there's still all the cash drawers in the front of the bank and a small safe, or multiple safes, somewhere else, usually in an office in the back. You can open these standard safes with safe codes .
The armored car parked outside has loot in it, too. The thing is, it may despawn while you're inside the bank. If you want to loot it, place a sticky explosive on the rear door, which won't let the truck despawn. (Be stealthy: there's another guard still watching the truck). When you leave the bank after the robbery, detonate the bomb and grab the loot.
The best way to enter a bank is through a back door, if the building has one, (using the snap gun to avoid alarms) or a roll-up door. If the guard you're following goes in the back, he may leave the doors unlocked behind him, and you may not even have to unlock any doors at all to reach the vault. Just be prepared to run into multiple security guards and employees you'll need to subdue.

articles.t: GTA 6 à 120 FPS sur PS6 et Xbox Helix, un insider dévoile ses estimations
articles.chapeau: Bloqué à 30 FPS sur PS5 et Xbox Series, GTA 6 rallume pourtant le débat performance avec une fuite ciblant la future PS6 et la Xbox Project Helix. Jusqu’où ces consoles next gen pourraient pousser le compteur d’images par seconde ?
articles.txt:
Bloqué à 30 FPS sur PS5 et Xbox Series, GTA 6 rallume pourtant le débat performance avec une fuite ciblant la future PS6 et la Xbox Project Helix. Jusqu’où ces consoles next gen pourraient pousser le compteur d’images par seconde ?
Pour l’instant, les joueurs consoles vivent GTA 6 en 30 FPS fixes, que ce soit sur PS5 , PS5 Pro ou Xbox Series X|S . Aucun mode 40 ou 60 FPS n’est proposé, Rockstar Games assumant ce choix pour préserver la densité de l’open world et les effets de ray tracing.
Une nouvelle fuite relance pourtant l’espoir des amateurs de fluidité. Le leaker Moore’s Law Is Dead affirme que GTA 6 pourrait tourner en 60 FPS, voire viser un mode 120 FPS, sur la future PlayStation 6 et la Xbox Project Helix . De quoi faire rêver ceux qui jouent déjà sur des téléviseurs 120 Hz.
Sur les machines actuelles, les analyses de Digital Foundry parlent d’un rendu autour du 1440p à 30 FPS sur PS5 et Xbox Series X , avec un avantage pour Xbox grâce au 120 Hz et au VRR. Un bug Quick Resume sur Xbox peut même pousser temporairement GTA 6 au delà de 40 FPS, mais en accélérant le jeu, ce qui le rend injouable.
C’est dans ce contexte que Moore’s Law Is Dead affirme que PS6 et Xbox Helix auront un GPU au niveau d’une GeForce RTX 5080 : dans sa vidéo, il parle d’« the equivalent of a 5080 for the GPU », citation rapportée par Notebookcheck. Selon lui, un 60 FPS stable serait réaliste, avec un mode 120 FPS pensé comme option performance, même si l’insider Kepler_L2 reste nettement plus prudent sur la PS6 .
D’après ces fuites , la PlayStation 6 viserait jusqu’à 40 Compute Units RDNA 5 . Moore’s Law Is Dead va jusqu’à dire que ce GPU pourrait dépasser une RTX 5080 en ray tracing et se rapprocher d’une Radeon RX 9070 XT en rasterisation, ce qui placerait une version next gen de GTA 6 bien au delà des consoles actuelles.
La Xbox Project Helix irait plus loin encore avec jusqu’à 56 Compute Units RDNA 5 , davantage de bande passante mémoire et un recours massif au FSR pour reconstruire une image 4K. Côté processeur, Helix passerait de 8 cœurs Zen 2 à jusqu’à 11 cœurs Zen 6 au delà de 4 GHz, de quoi gommer le goulot d’étranglement CPU qui empêche déjà aujourd’hui GTA 6 de grimper au dessus des 30 FPS.
Moore’s Law Is Dead évoque une mise en production de la PS6 au deuxième trimestre 2027, pour une sortie entre fin 2027 et début 2028. Xbox Helix viserait la même fenêtre , mais avec un positionnement bien plus haut de gamme, autour de 1 000 à 1 200 dollars, soit environ 950 à 1 150 € en Europe.
Dans ce scénario, un Grand Theft Auto VI « Enhanced » pour PS6 et Xbox Helix avec un mode 60 FPS paraît très probable, tandis qu’un mode 120 FPS resterait conditionné à des compromis sur la résolution et le ray tracing. Tant que Rockstar Games ne confirme rien, ces chiffres doivent être vus comme des objectifs ambitieux plutôt que comme une promesse ferme.

articles.txt:
GTA 6 regorge d’activités criminelles nécessitant bien souvent d’ouvrir le feu et de se confronter à d’autres truands. Cela dit, une occupation bien plus chill sur le papier vous rapportera également un peu d’argent. Il s’agit des trésors de Kenton, un homme pris d’intérêt pour les découvertes précieuses d’épaves échouées. On vous liste dans cet article l’intégralité des trésors à trouver pour chaque épave.
Comment et pourquoi récupérer les trésors de Kenton ? À partir de la mission Island Dreams du Chapitre 1 de GTA 6 , il deviendra possible de faire de la plongée et de récupérer les trésors oubliés d’épaves de bateaux . Il suffira tout d’abord d’attendre que Kenton vous donne des destinations à aller explorer, puis prendre son bateau pour vous y rendre.
Avant d’aller à l’eau, il est impératif d’enfiler le matériel de plongée contenant la tenue de plongée, une bouteille d’oxygène, un fusil-harpon ainsi qu’un détecteur de métaux. Dans un second temps, Kenton équipera votre bateau du matériel en question.
Ensuite, équipez-vous du détecteur de métaux grâce au menu rapide avec L1/LB et visez autour de l’épave. Lorsque le détecteur s’allume en vert, c’est que vous pointez dans la direction d’un trésor, et lorsque le signal sonore devient de plus en plus intense, c’est que vous vous rapprochez de son emplacement exact . Faites attention aux requins, que vous pouvez tuer grâce au fusil-harpon, et prenez garde aussi à des dangers comme les méduses, qui feront baisser votre vie à leur approche.
Quand vous terminez une exploration d’épave, les trésors de Kenton doivent être revendus à Kenton lui-même, à sa boutique de Key Lento. Plusieurs milliers de dollars sont à se faire grâce à cette activité.
7 épaves contenant des trésors pour Kenton sont à fouiller dans le monde ouvert de Leonida. Notez que pour obtenir le 100% du jeu, 5 sets complets de trésors sur 7 sont demandés . Voici la liste des épaves ainsi que les trésors que vous y trouverez.

articles.t: « Run Away With Me » : GTA 6 fait bondir de 288 % les écoutes d’une chanson de Carly Rae Jepsen sortie il y a onze ans
articles.chapeau: La chanteuse canadienne révélée au grand public avec « Call Me Maybe » connaît un bond d’écoutes grâce au jeu vidéo GTA 6.
articles.txt:
Comme la chanson « Danse ta vie » de Sylvie Vartan, sortie il y a plus de 40 ans, « Run Away With Me », le tube de Carly Rae sorti en 2015, connaît une nouvelle jeunesse. La chanson de l’interprète de « Call Me Maybe » a vu ses écoutes presque quadrupler entre deux samedis, dans la foulée de la sortie du jeu de Rockstar Games GTA 6, rapporte Rolling Stone .
Samedi 21 novembre, le morceau enregistrait 196 059 écoutes à la demande dans le monde, contre 50 425 le samedi précédent, selon les données de la société spécialisée Luminate. Soit une hausse de 288 %.
Le jour même de la sortie du jeu, le morceau avait déjà été écouté 170 094 fois dans le monde, soit 50 % de plus que la veille et 215 % de plus que le même jour de la semaine précédente, précise le magazine américain.
La chanson, qui a déjà 11 ans, apparaît à plusieurs reprises dans le jeu vidéo de Rockstar Games. On peut l’entendre notamment lors d’une mission concernant Lucia , qui célèbre sa sortie de prison à bord d’un yacht. À un autre moment, lorsqu’elle enfourche son jet ski, le saxophone de « Run Away With Me » résonne. Les joueurs peuvent aussi retrouver la chanson pop sur Flash FM, l’une des radios qu’ils peuvent écouter dans le jeu.
Nouvelles séries, interviews exclusives, enquêtes... Retrouvez toutes nos vidéos au sein de notre nouvel univers
Deuxième single de l’album « Emotion », « Run Away With Me » avait atteint la 83e place du Billboard Hot 100 canadien à sa sortie, sans entrer dans le classement américain du même nom. Le morceau est depuis devenu l’un des favoris des fans de la chanteuse et cumule plus de 200 millions d’écoutes sur Spotify, relève Rolling Stone.
Depuis le début de la saga Grand Theft Auto, les créateurs du jeu accordent une grande importance à la bande-son qui accompagne les joueurs. Parmi les plusieurs centaines de titres disponibles sur les 22 stations radio du jeu, on peut retrouver des titres de Lana Del Rey, Camila Cabello ou Burna Boy .

articles.t: New 'GTA 6' Leak Is Great News For PC Gamers, But There's A Catch
articles.chapeau: A new leak gives PC players a sense of what to expect from GTA 6 with souped-up settings that aren't possible on PS5 Pro or Xbox
articles.txt:
Much has been said about the differences between Grand Theft Auto 6 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox , but how will Rockstar Games' open-world game fare on PC? An official port has yet to be announced, but a recent leak of the Xbox build of the game has kicked off a race to recompile the game and make it unofficially available on more platforms. As that work continues, yet another leak offers PC players some perspective on what might be possible in GTA 6 when the game isn't held down by console constraints.
On Wednesday, known GTA leaker Tex2 shared a Pastebin that lists GTA 6 's apparent console settings shipped by Rockstar. These are tunable options that exist to help the game shine on platforms with varying capacities, like the less-powerful Xbox Series S. The text dump has since been pulled by Pastebin, but Polygon viewed the document before the platform made it unavailable.
Some aspects of the game, like Global Illumination Quality, Ray Traced Directional Shadows, and Texture Quality are already set to high on PlayStation 5 . The same aspects are sometimes lower or altogether absent on Xbox, though reports suggest the platforms have more parity than Sony's marketing would like you to believe.
There are even a couple of settings that Rockstar has already set to Ultra, such as Vehicle Max Texture Quality and Bounding Volume Hierarchy. A surprising number of settings — 18 to be exact — are set to medium or low on PS5 and Xbox Series X​​​​​​​ . That number jumps to 38 settings on Xbox Series X that are set to low or medium.​​​​​​​
The conservative presets are of significance for PC gamers. Settings such as Tree, Terrain, Impostor, and Grass Shadows are set to medium and affect draw distance and pop-in.​​​​​​​ Lighting and Ambient Lighting, which influence​​​​​​​ how the game renders background lights such as streetlights and neon signs, are also set to medium across platforms.
Image: Rockstar Games Volumetric Lighting​​​​​​​ , another setting currently on medium, determines how light is depicted in conditions such as fog and crepuscular rays​​​​​​​ . On consoles, aspects like 'god rays' can appear grainy or blocky — especially​​​​​​​ while the camera is in motion.
Even elements that might sound small on paper, like Weapon Textures, could meaningfully change the experience. There's a lot of shooting in this game, even if you play non-lethally; players will stare down the barrel of a gun for much of the game.
Players experiencing GTA 6 on PS5 Pro have slightly more presets set to high than the base platform​​​​​​​ , but by and large, a potential PC port​​​​​​​ of the game will likely look much better than its console counterparts, depending on hardware configuration. GTA 6 is no graphics slouch , either — so it's almost hard to fathom how this incredible-looking game is still nowhere near its full potential​​​​​​​ .

articles.t: GTA 6 Netflix Extended Look: 27 Minutes After Leaks
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 Netflix extended look: 27 minutes of PS5 footage, a six-hour exclusive window and unconfirmed CyberLeek leaks. What is confirmed and what is not.
articles.txt:
Image: Rockstar Games Netflix and Rockstar Games put Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look in front of subscribers on August 27, 2026, at 3 p.m. ET. It ran 27 minutes, and every frame came from in-game footage captured on PlayStation 5. For a franchise that has spent years rationing glimpses of its next entry, that is a lot of new material in one sitting.
The reveal did not arrive cleanly. Before the Netflix premiere, unauthorised videos claiming to show Grand Theft Auto VI gameplay spread across the internet, and Rockstar publicly called seeing that footage shared online “heartbreaking.” The tension between a carefully staged streaming event and a messy leak cycle is the real story here, and it says a lot about how big game launches now work.
This analysis walks through what is confirmed, what is not, and why the Netflix route matters for the publisher, the platforms and the people who just want to know what the game looks like. It also separates the claims made by a group calling itself CyberLeek (which remain unconfirmed, as we covered in our look at the CyberLeek executable leak ) from the facts Rockstar and Netflix have put on the record. For more game coverage, see our gaming section .
Google · Preferred Sources Don't miss new tech stories on Google
Add Shattered once in the Google app and our stories show up in your news suggestions.
Start with the hard facts, because the leak noise has blurred them. Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look is an official Netflix release. It is a collaboration between Netflix and Rockstar Games, and Rockstar’s parent publisher is Take-Two Interactive. Netflix says the presentation contains 27 minutes of new footage, and that all of it was captured in-game on PlayStation 5.
That last detail carries weight. A reveal built entirely from captured gameplay, rather than pre-rendered cinematics, tells viewers they are seeing something close to what players will actually run on a console. Rockstar and Netflix did not publish a technical breakdown of the capture, so we cannot say anything about resolution, frame rate or settings. Anyone quoting those numbers is guessing.
The game itself was scheduled for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S on November 19, 2026. No PC date is part of the confirmed record. Variety covered the Netflix trailer and Extended Look release when it went live. That November date has since passed, and our reporting on what followed sits in the linked coverage further down.
The release schedule is unusual enough to deserve its own section. Netflix premiered the presentation at 3 p.m. ET on August 27 and held exclusive access for six hours. Rockstar stated that the footage would then move to YouTube and other platforms at 9 p.m. ET. In other words, anyone without a Netflix account had to wait until the evening, while subscribers could press play in the afternoon.
Six hours is short by streaming-exclusive standards. It is long enough to give Netflix a real marketing hook, since the service could tell its audience that the biggest game reveal of the year started on its platform. It is short enough that Rockstar did not lock a huge portion of its audience out for days. Think of it as a head start rather than a wall.
Publishers usually announce games on their own channels or at industry showcases. Putting a GTA presentation on a streaming service is a different play, and Brandon Riegg, Netflix’s VP of nonfiction series, explained the appeal in a single line. He said: “Grand Theft Auto reveals have become cultural moments in their own right.”
Read that statement from Netflix’s side and the logic is clear. The service wants appointment viewing from audiences who might not watch a games showcase. A GTA presentation carries mainstream name recognition that few other entertainment properties can match, and Netflix gets to position itself as a home for event programming beyond scripted shows.
From Rockstar’s side, the benefits are less obvious but still real. A Netflix premiere brings its own promotional machine. It also lets the studio control the presentation format, length and sequencing in a way a livestreamed press event rarely allows. A single 27-minute piece is easier to polish than a live broadcast with commentary and ad breaks. Nothing in the confirmed record tells us the financial terms of the deal, and we will not guess at them.

articles.t: GTA 6 : les réglages graphiques des consoles auraient fuité
articles.chapeau: Des réglages graphiques de GTA 6 auraient fuité : la PS5 Pro serait la seule console avec du ray tracing supplémentaire, la Xbox Series S tournerait en dessous.
articles.txt:
Hot GTA 6 : les réglages graphiques des consoles auraient fuité Les réglages graphiques de GTA 6 sur PS5, PS5 Pro, Xbox Series X et Xbox Series S auraient fuité depuis le build du jeu, d'après des informations non confirmées. La PS5 Pro serait la seule à profiter de fonctions de ray tracing en plus.
Suis-nous sur Google (nouvel onglet) Partager Garder pour plus tard Gardé pour plus tard Grand Theft Auto VI 514 205 sur Twitch Crédit : Rockstar Games, Take-Two Interactive Avec Grand Theft Auto 6 désormais en magasins, dataminers et modders se ruent sur le jeu pour tenter de le faire tourner sur PC. Le titre reste exclusif aux consoles, et Rockstar semble faire tout son possible pour bloquer ça. Sauf que d'autres détails fuiteraient quand même du build : les réglages graphiques de chaque plateforme.
Ces informations non confirmées viennent du dataminer Text2. Elles tombent pile au moment où PlayStation affirme que GTA 6 tourne au mieux sur PS5. Quatre machines sont concernées : la PS5 Pro (nom de code Trinity), la PS5 (Prospero), la Xbox Series X (Anaconda) et la Xbox Series S (Lockhart).
Premier constat : la PS5 de base et la Xbox Series X utiliseraient des préréglages graphiques identiques, la Xbox Series S tournerait sur des réglages plus bas, et la PS5 Pro serait la seule plateforme avec des fonctions de ray tracing supplémentaires. Voilà ce qui ressort :
Un second tableau, bien plus fouillé, creuse davantage. Côté éclairage, la Global Illumination est en Medium sur Xbox Series S, Xbox Series X et PS5, et en High sur PS5 Pro.
Pour les ombres, les Directional Shadows sont en Medium sur Xbox Series S et en High sur Xbox Series X et PS5. Sur PS5 Pro, elles passent en Low avec le ray tracing actif. Même schéma pour les Local Shadows : Low sur Xbox Series S, High sur Xbox Series X et PS5, Low (RT actif) sur PS5 Pro.
La BVH Quality (RT Structure) est en Low sur Xbox Series S, High sur Xbox Series X et PS5, et Ultra sur PS5 Pro. Les RT Directional Shadows, RT Local Shadows et RT LOD Light Shadows sont désactivés (Off) sur Xbox Series S, Xbox Series X et PS5, et activés (High, High, true) sur PS5 Pro.
La Shadow Alpha Quality est en Low sur Xbox Series S, Medium sur Xbox Series X et PS5, et High sur PS5 Pro. Les Tinted Alpha Shadows sont désactivés (false) sur Xbox Series S et activés (true) sur les trois autres machines.
Les Texture Quality sont en Medium sur Xbox Series S et en High sur Xbox Series X, PS5 et PS5 Pro. La Tessellation est en Low sur Xbox Series S et en High ailleurs. La Hair Quality suit la même logique : Medium sur Xbox Series S, High sur les trois autres.
Une série de réglages place la Xbox Series S en Low et les trois autres en Medium : Grass Shadows, Terrain / Tree / Imposter Quality, Texture Streaming / Timecycle, Weapon Max Textures et Volumetrics Lighting. Seule exception, les Terrain Shadow Quality, en Medium partout.
Le Decoration Res Shift est de 1 sur Xbox Series S et de 0 sur les trois autres. Le Grass LOD / Manual Mip Bias est de 0.8 / -1.5 sur Xbox Series S et en Default ailleurs. La Hair GPU Budget / Simulation et la Particle Lighting sont en Low sur Xbox Series S et en High sur Xbox Series X, PS5 et PS5 Pro.
Le Motion Blur Scale est en Default (limite 16.0) sur Xbox Series S, Xbox Series X et PS5, et à 1.5 (limite 16.0) sur PS5 Pro. Le Vehicle Max Textures / HD Count est en Medium / 0 sur Xbox Series S, et en Ultra / 2 sur les trois autres.
Les Water Sim & Surface Waves sont en Medium sur Xbox Series S et en High sur Xbox Series X, PS5 et PS5 Pro. La Water Tessellation est en Low sur Xbox Series S et en Default sur les autres.
Enfin, les AI (Behavior, Motion, etc.), la Pedestrian & Vehicle Density et la Physics Quality sont en Medium sur Xbox Series S et en High sur Xbox Series X, PS5 et PS5 Pro.
Les visuels viseraient donc un niveau medium à high sur toutes les plateformes sauf la Xbox Series S. Un mode 60 FPS en baissant davantage les réglages reste difficile à dire. En revanche, en coupant aussi la résolution de rendu, un mode 45 FPS pourrait être atteignable, au prix de la qualité graphique. Ce n'est qu'une hypothèse.
Autre point curieux : la PS5 Pro ne proposerait pas de mode sans ray tracing, alors que son mode actuel est décrit à 30 FPS .

articles.txt:
Une peine de sept ans de prison, sans retour immédiat derrière les barreaux. Arion Kurtaj, 21 ans, a été condamné lundi 23 novembre à Londres pour plusieurs piratages commis en 2021 et 2022, dont celui de Rockstar Games à l’origine de la fuite de vidéos de GTA 6. Il a toutefois quitté le tribunal libre, compte tenu du temps déjà passé en détention, rapporte Le Parisien avec l’AFP.
Le jeune homme avait plaidé coupable le 16 novembre dans des affaires visant également Revolut, Uber et l’opérateur britannique BT/EE. Selon l’accusation, il appartenait au groupe de pirates informatiques Lapsus$.
L’intrusion chez Rockstar avait été menée en septembre 2022 depuis un hôtel de Bicester, près d’Oxford. Arion Kurtaj y avait été installé pour sa protection, après des menaces de pirates rivaux cherchant à s’emparer de bitcoins volés, selon la police de la City de Londres, chargée de l’enquête.
Depuis sa chambre, il avait utilisé un téléphone portable, la télévision connectée au wifi et une clé Amazon Fire Stick pour accéder aux systèmes du studio. Il avait ensuite dérobé et publié 90 vidéos de GTA 6 sous le pseudonyme « TeaPotUberHacker », plus d’un an avant la diffusion des premières images officielles. Le parquet britannique indique qu’il avait également menacé de rendre public le code source du jeu.
Ces faits intervenaient après une première arrestation. Entre août et novembre 2021, Kurtaj s’était introduit dans les systèmes de BT/EE avant de détourner de l’argent et des cryptomonnaies appartenant à des clients. Inculpé, il avait été remis en liberté sous caution.
Son parcours judiciaire a ensuite été marqué par une hospitalisation dans un établissement sécurisé. En 2023, il avait été déclaré inapte à suivre un procès classique en raison de son autisme. Jugé apte à plaider à l’été 2025, il avait été transféré en prison en janvier 2026.
Au moment de prononcer la peine, le juge Mark Turner, de la Woolwich Crown Court, a expliqué avoir tenu compte de la gravité des faits, mais aussi de l’âge de l’accusé lorsqu’il les avait commis et de ses antécédents médicaux. Il l’a averti de ne pas récidiver.

articles.t: GTA 6 sur PC : les moddeurs implorent les IA de « travailler plus vite » après la fuite d’une build Xbox
articles.txt:
La course pour faire tourner Grand Theft Auto 6 sur PC prend une tournure inédite. Après la fermeture du projet communautaire Project Leonida par Rockstar, d’autres groupes de moddeurs ont repris le flambeau, s’appuyant sur une prétendue build Xbox quasi finale du jeu ayant fuité cette semaine. Leur méthode : demander à des IA génératives de décompiler et recompiler le code, avec des prompts aussi directs que « travaille plus vite » ou « ne fais aucune erreur ».
Le point de départ de cette nouvelle vague d’activité est la diffusion, par le leaker connu sous le pseudonyme CyberLeek , d’une version du jeu décrite comme « quasi finale » pour Xbox . Cette build servirait de base aux travaux de portage vers PC. Auparavant, les communautés de moddeurs utilisaient déjà des outils d’IA pour analyser le code de la version console, mais cette fuite a démultiplié les tentatives.
Sur les réseaux sociaux, l’utilisateur chasm , qui suit de près ces communautés, a partagé des captures d’écran des invites envoyées aux chatbots. On y voit des moddeurs, parfois en direct sur des plateformes de streaming, demander à l’IA de « continuer à chercher des choses et à travailler », ou encore de « trouver un moyen plus rapide d’itérer ». Ces échanges illustrent une dépendance croissante à l’égard des modèles de langage pour mener à bien une tâche aussi complexe que le portage d’un jeu AAA.
Rockstar n’est pas resté inactif. Après avoir obtenu la suppression du serveur Discord et du dépôt GitHub de Project Leonida – y compris ses 3 006 forks – l’éditeur semble désormais cibler les publications en ligne qui documentent l’avancement de ces projets. L’utilisateur chasm a ainsi indiqué que ses propres messages avaient été retirés « en réponse à un signalement du détenteur des droits d’auteur ».
Cette stratégie de répétition des DMCA n’est pas nouvelle, mais elle prend ici une ampleur particulière en raison de la notoriété du jeu et de la détermination des moddeurs. La fermeture de Project Leonida n’a pas découragé les autres groupes, qui semblent au contraire redoubler d’efforts pour être les premiers à proposer une version jouable sur PC.
Une vidéo partagée sur les réseaux sociaux montre le jeu tournant sur PC, dépassant le simple écran de démarrage que les moddeurs avaient atteint quelques heures après la fuite. Les images, qui s’affichent à moins de 5 images par seconde , témoignent d’un rendu visuel correct mais d’une optimisation encore très loin des standards. Ce résultat, bien que préliminaire, prouve que la décompilation et la recompilation progressent.
Si Rockstar ne parvient pas à stopper ces initiatives, de nouvelles mises à jour sur l’avancement du portage pourraient voir le jour dans les prochains jours. La communauté reste très active, et les diffusions en direct des sessions de codage assisté par IA attirent un public curieux.
Pour l’instant, Grand Theft Auto 6 n’a été officiellement annoncé que sur PlayStation 5 et Xbox Series X/S , avec une sortie prévue à l’automne 2025. Rockstar n’a donné aucune indication sur une éventuelle version PC, ce qui alimente la frustration d’une partie des joueurs et explique l’empressement des moddeurs à créer leur propre portage.
Cette situation n’est pas sans rappeler les précédents de GTA V ou Red Dead Redemption 2 , dont les versions PC sont arrivées bien après les sorties console. Mais l’utilisation massive d’outils d’IA pour accélérer le processus est une nouveauté qui pourrait changer la donne, tant pour les moddeurs que pour les éditeurs.
En attendant une éventuelle annonce officielle, les joueurs PC devront se contenter de suivre de loin les avancées de ces projets non officiels, tout en gardant à l’esprit les risques juridiques encourus par leurs auteurs.

Arion Kurtaj, the Lapsus$ hacker behind the 2022 Grand Theft Auto 6 leak, has been sentenced to seven years in prison at Woolwich Crown Court in London, and he walked out of court a free man on the same day, just four days after GTA 6 launched on consoles.
Kurtaj was released on license , the UK's version of parole, as the time he had already spent in a secure hospital and in prison awaiting trial counted toward the sentence. The judge called Kurtaj "a very talented young man" before warning him, "Don't let this happen again," and Kurtaj is now under a five-year Serious Crime Prevention Order that restricts his online activity, including bans on using messaging/communications platforms Telegram and Discord.
Kurtaj pleaded guilty to all six charges against him on November 16, 2026. According to the Crown Prosecution Service, those charges cover hacks on BT/EE, Revolut, Uber, and Rockstar Games, where Kurtaj took 90 GTA 6 gameplay videos, released them under the alias "TeaPotUberHacker," and then threatened to release the game's source code. The CPS says the Uber attack alone caused costs exceeding $2.8 million, while Rockstar previously told the court the GTA 6 hack cost it $5 million.
3 Grand Theft Auto 6 artwork frames two characters through a car window; the game was the subject of the 2022 Rockstar Games leak. Notably, Kurtaj was handed an indefinite hospital order in 2023 after being deemed unfit to stand trial, with a psychiatric assessment finding he " continued to express the intent to return to cyber-crime as soon as possible. " Kurtaj was later found fit to stand trial and moved to prison, and one of his six charges was for possessing a mobile phone in prison in March 2026, the same month Kurtaj hinted from custody that the GTA 6 source code was still out there .

articles.t: GTA 6 recompilers and vibe-coders implore AI chatbots to 'work faster' and 'make no mistakes' as they race to get the game running on PC
articles.chapeau: In the wake of Rockstar's takedown of the biggest community project working to make Grand Theft Auto 6 playable on PC, those remaining want to be the first to d
articles.txt:
Things continue to get messy in the community of players working on getting Grand Theft Auto 6 working on PC. The previous frontrunner, Project Leonida, got their Discord server and GitHub repository taken down by Rockstar , but others have seemingly stepped in to finish the job.
The most up-to-date build of GTA 6 was allegedly leaked earlier this week by notorious leaker CyberLeek . This is a supposedly near-final build of the game's Xbox version, and it's seemingly being used as the basis for the recent work to port the game to PC.
Unsurprisingly, most of these communities of modders rely almost exclusively on generative-AI tools like Claude and Antigravity to decompile and recompile the console version of GTA 6. That has always been the case, but the CyberLeek build only invited even more to ask AI chatbots to make the PC port for them.
X user chasm has been following developments in the GTA 6 decompile and recompile communities, and recently shared some of the prompts the so-called vibe-coders are using - a few of whom livestreamed the process.
"Make no mistakes," one modder prompted the AI chatbot. "Keep finding more stuff and working and pushing," another eloquently asked . "Work faster," asked another . "There has to be a faster way to iterate than this," they continued.
Rockstar, which successfully managed to DMCA take down Project Leonida - including all of its 3,006 forks on lead author NotRexed's GitHub - is seemingly also going after people online discussing the community's progress. The X user in question later revealed they may no longer be able to share these updates, as their posts have also been removed "in response to a report by the copyright owner" .
As for how far some of the remaining communities have managed to get, this video allegedly shows the game running on PC . This goes beyond the boot-up screen, which modders were able to reach within hours of CyberLeek's build alleged leaking .
The footage runs at sub-5fps, but the visuals look to have rendered normally. Assuming Rockstar doesn't also shut down the modders who remain active, we may see another progress update.
If you're already playing Rockstar's latest on consoles, the Eurogamer GTA 6 walkthrough offers comprehensive guides on relationship mechanics , how the new Criminal Profile system works , a list of all safe codes and more.

articles.t: Take-Two Appears to Be Trying to Scrub GTA 6 PC Ports From the Internet, as Vibecoders Race Toward Controversial World First
articles.chapeau: Take-Two appears to be taking on the many GTA 6 PC ports currently in the works following Cyberleek’s alleged release of an unauthorized Xbox build of the game.
articles.txt:
Take-Two appears to be taking on the many GTA 6 PC ports currently in the works following Cyberleek’s alleged release of an unauthorized Xbox build of the game.
This week, Cyberleek allegedly released the executable file for the incomplete GTA 6 Xbox build they reportedly leaked the week prior, sparking a race within the homebrew scene to port the build to PC. There’s even a website tracking the various attempts to recompile, emulate, or port the leaked Xbox Series build to PC.
But it looks like Take-Two is taking action, reportedly convincing GitHub to delete an entire network of 3,007 repositories via a DMCA takedown notice.
The takedown we know about relates to ItsNotRexed's GitHub repository and the over 2,900 forks attached to it, which Take-Two said facilitated copyright infringement of GTA 6. Take-Two alleged that the repository Project Leonida repository "exceeds the license Rockstar Games grants to users, constituting copyright infringement.” Here, Take-Two claimed that the repository violated at least Section 2.3 of Rockstar Games’ terms of service:
Additionally, there’s an interesting note in the takedown order that addresses the “bring your own files” defence we’ve seen so often from the homebrew community when it comes to unofficial ports of video games. As you’d expect, Take-Two isn’t in favor of it, insisting that in this case, the files the user must provide come from the unauthorized GTA 6 Xbox build Cyberleek leaked online.
According to now deleted social media posts, NotRexed, author of the Leonida project, shut it down entirely. There are also screenshots of its Discord showing users posting disclaimers distancing themselves from Project Leonida in case of a federal investigation.
However, many similar projects remain active, risking similar action from Take-Two. Seemingly undeterred, these projects are ongoing, with some getting close to creating a PC port of GTA 6 that is somewhat playable. Some are even streaming their efforts, showing how they are vibecoding a port using agent prompts such as "make no mistakes," "keep finding more stuff and working and pushing," and "work faster."
This is of course a nightmare scenario for Take-Two and Sony and Microsoft, which are benefiting greatly from GTA 6 releasing on console only. The console version of GTA 6 targets 30fps across all platforms, although struggles at times to hit that on base PS5, and Xbox Series X and S. As a result, there is huge interest in a potential PC version offering 60fps gameplay.
As you've probably seen from various viral clips on social media, people are using AI to create clones of popular games and release them on platforms they're not normally available on. We've seen everything from Minecraft playable inside X/Twitter to modders crashing Minecraft and Elden Ring together . Indeed, last month, Rockstar's own Grand Theft Auto 5 was made playable in a browser before it was pulled offline.
Seemingly in response, Anthropic issued an update for Claude that made it harder for people to use the AI model to generate video game clones. In an interview with IGN sister site RPS , former Rockstar North technical director Obbe Vermeij said that Rockstar Games may be keen to port GTA 6 to PC as soon as possible , due to the explosion of AI-generated clones and ports.
Some of this concern has to do with the security of the PS5, with Sony seemingly engaged in a game of Whac-a-Mole with hackers who are trying to jailbreak the latest firmware. If a PS5 jailbreak is made available for the firmware that is required by GTA 6 to run, it may be possible for Rockstar’s game to be pirated on PS5 and subsequently made available on PC.
Earlier this month, Strauss Zelnick, the boss of Take-Two, responded to the threat of AI-assisted reverse-engineering and decompilation of games in an interview with IGN. He said he was taking the issue seriously, and insisted that fans will prefer to play GTA 6 officially, with all its bells and whistles as Rockstar intended, over an unofficial PC version.

And there is some concern about this leading to potentially GTA 6 being made available on PC unofficially or places that you aren't releasing it. I was just wondering how much of a threat this is to your business? And, is there anything meaningful you can do about it?
